src: ; 07 matmul — C = A x B for 8x8 matrices, one thread per output element
;   int row = i / 8, col = i % 8, acc = 0;
;   for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) acc += A[row*8 + k] * B[k*8 + col];
; The inner loop is one MAD per iteration — the multiply-accumulate that
; Tensor Cores do thousands of at once. Note the access patterns: within a
; warp every lane reads the SAME A element (a broadcast, 1 transaction) and
MAD   R3, R0, R1, R2        ; i
MAD   R8, R10, R11, R8      ; acc += a * b
